title: English Practice Quiz 0977
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A bank statement shows ___.
options: transactions in an account over a period

questions.question: An 'account balance' is the amount of money ___.
options: printed on a cheque book cover
questions.explanation: The balance is the amount recorded as available or held, subject to account terms.

questions.question: A PIN should be ___.
questions.explanation: A PIN is confidential security information.

questions.question: A bank transfer moves money ___.
options: from a wallet into a photograph
questions.explanation: A transfer moves funds between accounts.

questions.question: If you notice an unauthorised transaction, you should ___.
options: contact your bank through an official channel promptly
share your OTP with the caller
questions.explanation: Promptly notifying the bank helps it investigate and protect the account.

questions.question: An ' instalment' payment is made ___.
options: in one of several scheduled parts
questions.explanation: An instalment is one of a series of scheduled payments.

questions.question: A cheque is a written instruction to a bank to ___.
questions.explanation: A cheque instructs a bank to pay money from an account, subject to validity.

questions.question: A transaction reference number helps ___.
questions.explanation: A reference number helps locate a specific transaction.

questions.question: Before scanning a QR code to pay, verify ___.
options: the recipient name and amount shown by the payment app
the colour of the phone case
questions.explanation: Confirming recipient and amount reduces payment errors.

questions.question: An ' overdraft' is a facility that may allow an account holder to ___.
options: withdraw more than the available balance up to an agreed limit
questions.explanation: An overdraft is a borrowing facility with agreed terms and limits.
